superficial: A curved wall, facing whoever arrives. Six rows of signs, each in a different script: dots, dashes, wedges, rings, hooks, diamonds. Names, perhaps. Or dates.
The last row is smooth. No one has written on it yet.
profunda: You look for the marks of the Absent among the rows and find them: the names of the Council, of those who crossed before the silence.
The three from the Laboratory are not there. They never crossed: they stayed behind, finishing, while years went by outside.

superficial: Four sandstone mouths in an arc, like the ones at home. Through each one you can see Home: the Hall of Fragments full, the Institute younger, Home at dusk. The fourth is sealed with a slab and an open ring: "soon".
Beside each mouth, a stele with its clock. No two show the same hour.
profunda: What you see on the other side is not the day you arrive on. Each mouth runs its view by its own lag.
Only one leaves you home before the test.

superficial: On the Bench, just like the one in the Laboratory, three rolls of paper and a loose sheet with a ring drawn on it: the plans of the Counterweight.
Whoever takes them back could build another. Or could choose not to.
profunda: Now you know what you are holding. In the Institute's workshop there is a brass ring that opens for eleven seconds and cannot keep still.
This is exactly what it is missing.

superficial: On a low slab, other people's things: a long helmet with three visors, a long-handled tool you cannot guess the use of, five stacked stones, a notebook open in a script you cannot read, and three snuffed candles.
No one took them when they crossed. Or no one came back for them.
A mouth of the Absent, larger than the rest and split in two: one piece standing, the other fallen beside it. A thread of light from its side still leaks through the crack.
On the plinth, three rows of notches: a date. Below, smaller, the same sign as on the plaque at Threshold. It is the first one they opened. The one that closed badly.
Above, there are no stars: there are mouths. Hundreds, turning slowly around you, each with a different sky inside. Beyond them, an enormous ring of light surrounds everything.
Rings of light run across the ground from the mouths of home, one after another, unhurried. Here time does not pass: it shows.
